education.title: Why AI-Driven Modern Classrooms Require a Major Security Conversation
education.snippet:
When I walk into a modern classroom now, I don’t just see audiovisual gear. I see endpoints.
The pan-tilt-zoom camera at the back of the room isn’t only for lecture capture now; it’s a sensor on the network. The speakers in the ceiling aren’t just to enhance video clips. education.title: Let’s work to keep our students while we still have them
education.snippet: According to research I recently saw , About 16% of young people ages 18 to 24 are not in employment, education, or training. Researchers call them NEETs, or disconnected youth. After 35 years in public education, I read the number a different way.

education.title: How University IT Leaders Can Budget for Volatile AI Pricing Models
education.snippet:
For many higher ed institutions, budgeting for artificial intelligence lately can look a lot like dropping quarters into a magic Zoltar fortune teller machine: You put your tokens in to get an answer, but you have no idea what it’s going to truly cost you until the bill comes. The allure of AI is real, but many are signing up without reading the fine print on consumption pricing.

education.title: Quit saying “I’m not a math person”
education.snippet: It’s quite rare to hear someone say, “I can’t read” or “I’m illiterate so I don’t read.” On the other hand, lots of people claim that they’re “not a math person.” The phrase isn’t just “I don’t like math.”
